 HOLLYWOOD, CALIFORNIA - NOVEMBER 15: Charlize Theron attends the 17th Governors Awards at Dolby Theatre on November 15, 2026 in Hollywood, California. (Photo by Monica Schipper/Getty Images) HOLLYWOOD, CALIFORNIA - NOVEMBER 15: Timothée Chalamet attends the 17th Governors Awards at Dolby Theatre on November 15, 2026 in Hollywood, California. (Photo by Monica Schipper/Getty Images) Inde Navarrette at the 17th Governors Awards held at The Ray Dolby Ballroom at Ovation Hollywood on November 15, 2026 in Los Angeles, California. Zendaya at the 17th Governors Awards held at The Ray Dolby Ballroom at Ovation Hollywood on November 15, 2026 in Los Angeles, California. 
 Charlize Theron, Timothée Chalamet, Inde Navarrette, Pedro Pascal, Olivia Wilde, Lea Seydoux, Florence Pugh and many more walked the Governors Awards red carpet in Hollywood tonight.
 After eight nominations over the past 44 years, Glenn Close is finally getting her close-up with Oscar; and after a feature directorial career that didn’t even begin until he was 40, and is still going strong, 88-year-old Ridley Scott is finally also getting long-deserved recognition from the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences. Both have been selected to receive Honorary Oscars tonight.
 Close and Scott will be joined by legendary Disney animator Floyd Norman, who is also receiving an honorary statuette. Additionally being honored this year are indie producing stalwarts Christine Vachon and Pamela Koffler, who have been named recipients of the Irving G. Thalberg Memorial Award, now an Oscar statuette instead of the bust of the man it is named for.
 Scroll through the gallery below to see photos of them all.
